name: Minecraft Bedrock
description: Self-hosted Minecraft Bedrock Edition dedicated server. Compatible with iPad/iPhone, Android, Switch, Xbox, PlayStation, and Minecraft for Windows. Powered by the itzg/docker-minecraft-bedrock-server image, which downloads and auto-upgrades the Mojang dedicated server binary on container start. Exposes UDP 19132 (IPv4) and 19133 (IPv6).
short_desc: Bedrock Edition server for iPad, Switch, Xbox, Win10 and mobile
author: itzg

form_fields.label: Server Name
form_fields.hint: Shown to clients in the LAN/Friends list.

form_fields.label: Enable Allow List (Whitelist)
form_fields.hint: Restrict who can join. First boot with this OFF, have the kids join once, then grab their XUIDs from the server logs, add them below, and turn this ON.

form_fields.label: Allow List Users
form_fields.hint: gamertag:xuid pairs, comma-separated. XUIDs are printed in the server logs the first time each player joins.

form_fields.label: Operators (Admins)
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated gamertags or XUIDs that get operator privileges (admin commands).

form_fields.label: Level Seed
form_fields.hint: Leave blank for a random world.

form_fields.label: Bedrock Server Version
form_fields.hint: Use LATEST to auto-upgrade on each container start, PREVIEW for the preview channel, or pin to a specific version like 1.21.50.10.
